newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firmer.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Spring/White Wheat - Spring wheat bids firmer.

text.p: Bids for dark northern spring wheat were higher on Tuesday, in line with gains in MGE futures, as concerns mounted that damp weather would foster development of scab, several cash grain dealers said.

The annual Wheat Quality Council spring wheat tour kicked off on Tuesday and scouts detected moderate scab infestation. Tour members said scab infestation ranged from nil to 20 percent in the first few fields scouted in North Dakota. The tour will view more fields in Minnesota and South Dakota before wrapping up on Thursday.
"We're seeing some farmers trying to clean out bins," a Montana dealer said. "It's buggy and musty and damaged. They're just trying to clear some space for the new crop."
Farmers were expected to start cutting spring wheat in South Dakota next week, with harvest expected to progress north over the next two to three weeks.
